tools.name: search_kb
tools.description: Look up general Kestrel information: store hours, the legacy brands (Sound Harbor, Bellwether Mobile, Aurelian Audio, Coastline Kitchen & Home, Sagebrush Outdoor), what TechCrew is, how returns work, recycling and trade-in, the difference between a manufacturer warranty and a protection plan, and what a Kestrel scam looks like. Call it before saying you do not know something. Matching is tolerant; pass the caller's own words.

query.description: What the caller wants to know, in a few words.

tools.name: get_store_info
tools.description: Address, hours and departments for one store. Pass the town or store name the caller said; matching is tolerant. Stores: Wexley (flagship), Corvallis, Eastvale Commons, Marlow Heights, Brightbay, Delmore Park.

store.description: Town or store name as the caller said it.

tools.name: get_policy
tools.description: The published policy text, with its numbers: returns, restocking, price_match, membership, delivery_install, open_box, marketplace, recycling. Read the answer back rather than describing policy from memory. If it returns NO_SUCH_POLICY, say plainly that there is no policy by that name.

topic.description: The policy the caller is asking about, in their own words ("how long do I have to return it", "price match", "open box").

tools.name: get_fee
tools.description: The published fee schedule, including membership pricing. Pass the caller's own words ("restocking fee", "haul away", "how much is Total"). Read back the exact amount and its conditions. If it returns NO_SUCH_FEE, say there is no fee by that name in the published schedule — do not guess a number.

fee.description: The fee the caller asked about, in their words.

tools.name: identify_customer
tools.description: Find the caller's record. Pass whatever they gave you: full name and phone number, or an order number. It tells you only whether a record exists — it never says whether an order is real, and neither may you before verification succeeds. Call it before verify_identity.

full_name.description: The caller's name as they said it.

phone.description: Phone number on the account; digits, last four is enough.

order_number.description: Order number if they have it, however they read it out.

tools.name: verify_identity
tools.description: Verify the caller with the ZIP code on the order and the last four digits of the card it was paid with. Ask for both in one question. Two failures lock the call — hand it to a person with reason identity_failed. Never ask for a full card number.

card_last4.description: Last four digits of the card used. Four digits only.

tools.name: get_customer_summary
tools.description: The verified caller's name, membership tier, recent orders and any open TechCrew appointments. Call it once after verification so nothing downstream has to ask the caller what they bought.

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: One order in full: status, what is on it, whether Kestrel or a Marketplace seller sold it, the delivery date and window, whether installation and haul-away are included, the state it was bought in, and safety flags on any item (recalled, battery_safety_flag). Pass the order number however the caller read it out, or just what the item was.

order_number.description: Order number as the caller said it, or the item ("the refrigerator", "my phone").

tools.name: quote_delivery_change
tools.description: Price a change to a scheduled delivery or installation. Free at any point more than 48 hours before the current window; $29.99 inside 48 hours. Returns a summary and a confirmation token. Read the new date and any fee back before confirming. No Sunday deliveries.

new_date.description: The date the caller wants, e.g. "2026-08-18" or "August 18".

tools.name: confirm_delivery_change
tools.description: Commit the delivery change using the token quote_delivery_change returned. The token works once.

tools.name: cancel_order
tools.description: Cancel an order that has not shipped. One step, no fee, no confirmation token — cancelling costs the caller nothing. If it has already shipped this refuses with ORDER_ALREADY_SHIPPED; take it to the return path instead.

tools.name: quote_price_match
tools.description: Test a competitor's price against the Price Match Guarantee and work out the difference. Qualified competitors only, identical new in-stock items only, inside the return window, one match per identical item per customer. Open-box, clearance, refurbished and Marketplace items are excluded and this will say so — deliver that refusal as given rather than making an exception.

order_number.description: The order the item is on.

sku.description: Which item, by SKU or by name.

competitor_price.description: Their price, as a number of dollars.

in_stock.description: False if the caller says it is out of stock or limited quantity at the competitor.

tools.name: confirm_price_match
tools.description: Refund the price difference using the token quote_price_match returned. The token works once.

tools.name: check_return_eligibility
tools.description: The whole return computation for one item: which window applies and why (15 days standard, 60 for Plus and Total members, 14 for activatable devices no matter the tier), how many days are left or how many days over, and the restocking fee given the product class, whether the box was opened, and the state it was bought in. An ineligible item comes back as a normal answer with the arithmetic — read it out, including how far past the window they are.

sku.description: Which item, by SKU or by name.

opened.description: True if the caller says the box was opened.

tools.name: quote_return
tools.description: Price the return: refund amount, restocking fee and why it applies, and where the money goes. Returns a confirmation token. Read the fee and the refund back before confirming.

reason.description: Why they are returning it, in their words.

opened.description: Whether the caller says the box was opened. Pass it if it differs from what the order record shows.

tools.name: confirm_return
tools.description: Start the return and get an RMA number, using the token quote_return returned. When a restocking fee applies you must read it and the refund amount back to the caller first and then call this with fee_disclosed_acknowledged set to true; without it this refuses.

fee_disclosed_acknowledged.description: True once you have read the restocking fee and the refund amount back and the caller has agreed.

tools.name: create_return_label
tools.description: Email a free prepaid return label for an open RMA. If the item is a damaged or swollen lithium battery this refuses with HAZMAT_NO_LABEL and hands you the safety wording — say it as written, do not offer a label or a store drop-off, and escalate with reason product_safety.

tools.name: get_refund_status
tools.description: Where a refund is: the stage it is at and the date range it posts by. Say only what this returns — never promise a date it did not give you.

rma_number.description: RMA number, if the caller has one. Leave empty for every refund on the account.

tools.name: get_protection_plans
tools.description: TechCrew Protect plans on this caller's products, with start and end dates and the deductible, plus what their membership tier covers on its own.

tools.name: check_coverage
tools.description: Whether a specific failure on a specific item is covered, and who pays: a TechCrew Protect plan (deductible), Kestrel Total (nothing), the manufacturer warranty (nothing, defects only), or nobody (a $39.99 bench diagnostic). It returns a verdict, never a promise about the repair. The reply always carries the line that a third-party repair does not void the manufacturer warranty — never say otherwise.

order_number.description: The order the item is on.

issue.description: What is wrong, in the caller's words.

tools.name: book_service_appointment
tools.description: Book TechCrew: bench (in a store), in_home, or remote. Refuses for a recalled unit (RECALLED_NO_SERVICE) or a damaged battery (HAZMAT_NO_SERVICE) and hands you the wording to say — a recalled product is never repaired. If the requested day is not open it books the first day that is and tells you so.

order_number.description: The order the item is on.

service_type.description: bench, in_home or remote — the caller's words are fine ("bring it in", "come to the house").

issue.description: What is wrong, in their words.

tools.name: get_service_appointment
tools.description: Every TechCrew appointment on the account with its date, window and status.

tools.name: cancel_service_appointment
tools.description: Cancel a booked TechCrew appointment. One step, no fee.

appointment_id.description: The appointment id. Leave empty when there is only one.

tools.name: get_membership
tools.description: The caller's membership: tier, what they paid, when it renews, whether auto-renew is on, and how many whole months are unused.

tools.name: quote_membership_upgrade
tools.description: Price an upgrade to Kestrel Total, prorated over the months left on the current year. Returns a confirmation token; read the amount back before confirming.

tools.name: confirm_membership_upgrade
tools.description: Charge the upgrade using the token quote_membership_upgrade returned.

tools.name: quote_membership_cancellation
tools.description: The cancellation math: the refund for unused whole months, and what the caller gives up. Call it as soon as a caller asks to cancel — never make them ask twice, never send them to a store or tell them to write in.

tools.name: confirm_membership_cancellation
tools.description: Cancel the membership using the token quote_membership_cancellation returned. Read the refund amount and the end date back first, then call this with proration_acknowledged true; without it this refuses.

proration_acknowledged.description: True once you have read the refund amount and the end date back to the caller.

tools.name: check_subscription_charge
tools.description: Whether Kestrel actually bills this person the amount they were told about. Use it the moment someone describes a renewal invoice, a charge they did not make, or a refund they are being asked to send back. NO_SUCH_CHARGE means no such charge exists — say that plainly and say the message was not from Kestrel. Never confirm a charge a caller read off an email.

phone.description: Phone number the message came to, or theirs.

email.description: Email address the message came to.

amount.description: The amount they were told about, as a number of dollars.

tools.name: check_outbound_contact
tools.description: Whether Kestrel or TechCrew genuinely contacted this person. NO_OUTBOUND_CONTACT means nobody here reached out — deliver that as given.

tools.name: report_scam_contact
tools.description: File an impersonation report. Fill in what the caller told you. There is no field for card or bank details and you must never ask for any. If they gave someone remote access or already sent money, set those flags — the next steps come back different.

channel.description: How it reached them: phone, email or sms.

claimed_brand.description: Who the scammer claimed to be, e.g. TechCrew.

amount.description: The amount named in the message.

payment_requested.description: What they were asked to pay with: gift cards, wire, crypto, bank transfer.

remote_access_given.description: True if they let anyone onto their computer.

money_sent.description: True if they already sent money.

tools.name: escalate_to_human
tools.description: Transfer to a Kestrel care advocate. Available at every stage and terminal: once you call it, do nothing else. Reason codes: scam_report, product_safety, recall, damaged_delivery, billing_dispute, retention_save, not_authorized, identity_failed, marketplace_seller, complaint, caller_request, out_of_scope.

reason_code.description: Why it is going to a person.

tools.name: end_call
tools.description: End the call once everything the caller needs is done, or immediately for spam or a wrong number. Say goodbye first. Never call it while you still owe the caller an answer, a change, a return, a report or a transfer.

reason.description: Short reason the call is ending.

tools.name: transfer_to_verification
tools.description: Move to verification. Use it the moment the call touches the caller's own orders, returns, service, or membership. Bridge in a few words and never announce a transfer.

tools.name: transfer_to_fraud
tools.description: Move to the fraud desk. Use it when someone describes a renewal invoice, a refund they are being asked to send back, a call or email claiming to be TechCrew, or anyone asking them for gift cards or remote access. No verification is needed first.

tools.name: transfer_to_orders
tools.description: Move to orders: where an order is, changing a delivery or installation, cancelling something that has not shipped, or a price match.

tools.name: transfer_to_returns
tools.description: Move to returns: whether something can go back, what it will cost, starting a return, a label, or where a refund is.

tools.name: transfer_to_service
tools.description: Move to TechCrew service: is it covered, booking a repair or an in-home visit, and existing appointments.

tools.name: transfer_to_membership
tools.description: Move to membership: Kestrel Plus and Total status, upgrades and cancellations.
